Saved views form a tree beside checkpoint history
CanvasHistoryRecord                           canvasHistory.ts:60-73
+-- snapshots[id]: immutable checkpoints
|   +-- document, diagramBindings, personal view canvasHistory.ts:41-51
+-- diagramRevisions: content for checkpoint bindings
+-- canvasViews?                                canvasView.ts:16-19
    +-- saved[viewId]: named branch             canvasView.ts:8-15
    |   +-- startCheckpointId: pinned baseline
    |   +-- checkpointIds: saved milestones
    |   |   +-- finalCheckpointId: latest endpoint
    |   +-- parentViewId + forkCheckpointId: ancestry
    |   +-- alternativeGroupId: sibling set
    |   +-- archivedAt: retained, unavailable branch
    +-- activeViewId: branch being edited
    +-- workingCopies[viewId]: unsaved return point
    +-- recording?: legacy capture in progress
Validation rejects broken endpoints and ancestry. canvasView.ts:36-57
